audit_target: The three research records committed under docs/design/ (2026-07-23 e2e research automation, 2026-07-24 empirical methods, 2026-07-24 primary-source self-optimisation) — the evidence base the capability roadmap draft cites as "47 Quellen, 45 adversarial verifizierte Claims".
provenance: Transcribed 2026-07-25 at the N2-T02 derivation, by hand, from the three committed record files. Every entry corresponds to an identifier written INLINE in a record; cited_as is the record's own surrounding label, quoted as it stands, and cited_in names the record file and line the identifier appears on. No entry is invented and no source is added that the records do not identify.
note_on_the_47: The roadmap draft's "47 Quellen" is a FETCH count, not a citation count: record I's header states "24 Quellen gefetcht", record II's "23 Quellen" (24+23=47). Those fetched source lists were never committed to this repository and do not exist as data anywhere in it — they cannot be audited, and this manifest does not pretend to cover them. What the records actually make machine-checkable is the set below: 21 distinct identifiers written inline (20 arXiv ids + 1 Nature article id). The gap between 47 fetched and 21 identified is a real, named limitation of the records, recorded here rather than smoothed over; closing it would mean the research harness committing its fetch list, which is a separate question and not this packet's business.
note_on_exclusions: Record III section B2 (AlphaEvolve, Google DeepMind) is cited with NO machine-checkable identifier at all — no arXiv id, no DOI, no URL. It is therefore outside this audit's reach and is deliberately NOT listed below: inventing an identifier for it would be exactly the fabrication this audit exists to detect. The exclusion is named, not silent.
note_on_titles: The records cite by system/short name plus identifier, not by paper title, so claimed_title is declared for exactly ONE entry — inspectable-ai-for-science, the only citation a record puts in quotation marks as a title. A short system name is NOT treated as a title claim, for a documented reason found at derivation: record III writes "Darwin Gödel Machine", while arXiv's own registered title transliterates to "Darwin Godel Machine"; treating the name as a claimed title would produce a title_mismatch verdict for a resolver-side transliteration, i.e. a false accusation of misattribution. As with the /e2e-automation survey, the primary verdict for this target is therefore EXISTENCE. claimed_title is never back-filled from a resolved title (that would be circular).
note_on_derived_urls: The records cite by identifier, not by URL, so cited_url here is DERIVED deterministically from the cited identifier (arXiv id -> https://arxiv.org/abs/<id>; the Nature article id -> https://www.nature.com/articles/<id>) and is NOT a verbatim transcription. It is recorded as a declared identifier because the frozen N2-T01 core treats cited_url as one; the audit's substantive verdict for every entry rests on the arXiv id or DOI, which ARE transcribed.
note_on_the_nature_doi: Record I cites the Nature paper by its article id "s41586-026-10265-5" without a DOI prefix. The doi below (10.1038/s41586-026-10265-5) is the article id with Nature's registrant prefix applied — a parse, exactly as the /e2e-automation manifest parsed identifiers out of cited URLs, not a string the record contains verbatim.
